confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors use the May 2026 Fez city averages; cocktail and wine prices use a current Morocco-wide range and may vary by licensed venue. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for budget guesthouses and riads, without live listing checks. MAD-to-USD anchor conversions are approximate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and coffee use Fez's own aggregated cost-of-living prices. Accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of affordable heritage-city guesthouses and riads in Morocco.
